## About
Certified Auto Service and Collision Center is an owner-run, family run shop on W Bellfort Ave in Houston. We do mechanical repair and maintenance under the same roof as our body shop, so one place can take care of most of what your car needs.
Our customers tend to talk about the same things: honest work, fair prices, and mechanics who explain your options instead of pushing the priciest one. Some have been coming to us for a long time, and we have a 4.8 rating from 112 Google reviews.
Stop by Monday through Saturday and tell us what your car is doing. We will take a look and give you a straight answer.

## Services
- Transmission repair: Transmission work, with clear options and updates along the way.
- Engine repair: Diagnosis and repair when your engine is not running the way it should.
- Body repair: Our body shop handles body repairs with care for the finish and the details, so your vehicle looks right again.
- State vehicle inspection: State vehicle inspections done at the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, we are open Saturday from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

Q: Can you take care of body repairs too?
A: Yes. Along with our mechanical services, we handle body repairs in our own body shop.

Q: Will you tell me what is going on with my car during the repair?
A: Yes. Customers say we keep in touch throughout the job and explain the repair options before the work is done.
